Preface 
This book serves as a memento to Ben’s "nal year 
project and graduation ceremony. 
Ben graduated university in 2024 achieving a First-
Class degree in Computer Science and ranking 2nd 
in his year. This included a placement year at 
Dyson, in Hullavington and Malmesbury. 
The goal of his "nal year project was to investigate 
the effects of using gami"cation and short-form 
content on learning through a mobile application. 
However, the real motivation for this project 
started much earlier. While Ben was studying at 
Malbank School & Sixth-Form College in Year ~9, 
he found existing solutions at the time to be poor 
quality.  
From then on, he never quite stopped thinking 
about this project.
